880-6763-8337.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6763-8337.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2173-4574-6798-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2173-4574-6798-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

4875-6798-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

2353-4691-6035.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-4691-6035.description:
Draw a card.
When you draw a card, Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until you have 5 life.
In response to the next trigger, cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}, giving a creature you control protection from your opponents until end of turn, drawing a card, and preventing yourself from losing the game this turn.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until your library is empty.

2131-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3197-4247-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-4247-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1052-3175-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4019-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3240-3899-6351-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

907-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Selesnya Sanctuary.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1322-1843-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-1843-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1090-3375-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

104-475-549-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-475-549-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

789-1580-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

880-2653-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-4465-6972.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it.
When Basal Sliver dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

2167-6557-7380-7386.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Woodland Chasm, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Woodland Chasm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Woodland Chasm enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5470-6791-6798.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

625-1978-7308.description:
Cause Mona Lisa to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat from step 2.

4559-5686-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-5686-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5686-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-1770-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve both Skullport Merchant triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

5147-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

539-5414-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

315-4311-4465--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

560-2034-4210-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Wayward Disciple triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
560-2034-4210-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

997-1274-2086.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

149-4831-6006.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

643-3767-3918-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
643-3767-3918-5527.description:
Activate Trazyn using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

792-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2105-4636-5870-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Combat Celebrant token enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Guide of Souls trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.. The token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

803-1486-1719-1753.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-1486-1719-1753.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
803-1486-1719-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

186-2060-2445-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
186-2060-2445-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

997-3661-5220-5683.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

586-2921-5258-5618-5687.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2191-3769-6085.notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2191-3769-6085.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Altanak.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving control of Altanak to the opponent.
Activate Altanak an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

277-1315-5531-5732.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Port of Karfell can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
277-1315-5531-5732.description:
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}{B}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land other than Port of Karfell, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat step 2 until you control no other lands except Port of Karfell.
Activate Port of Karfell's second ability by paying {3}{U}{B}{B}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to mill four cards and return Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Lumra enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Lumra's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

1115-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

618-2732-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Prowling Geistcatcher with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, the nontoken and token Prowling Geistcatcher's first abilities trigger.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Prowling Geistcatcher token.
When the token Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability and the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers.
Resolve the nontoken Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the token Prowling Geistcatcher trigger, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

751-2653-3314-3861.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

221-1012-2018-2579-3977-5231.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Thermopod and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Thermopod dies, triggering Luminous Broodmoth and The Cauldron of Eternity.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Thermopod dies, triggering The Cauldron of Eternity, putting Thermopod on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

618-2846.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Vampires.
618-2846.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dominating Vampire with haste.
When the Dominating Vampire token enters, it triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki
Repeat.

732-1267-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai the Ageless and Felhide Spiritbinder do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Felhide Spiritbinder.
An opponent cannot block Medomai the Ageless.
732-1267-3745.description:
Declare Medomai the Ageless and Felhide Spiritbinder as attackers.
When Medomai the Ageless deals combat damage to a player, it triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Felhide Spiritbinder untaps in your next extra turn's untap step, it triggers, allowing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Identity Thief with haste.
Declare the Identity Thief token and Felhide Spiritbinder as attackers.
The Identity Thief token triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless, becoming a copy of Medomai the Ageless until end of turn, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
When the Identity Thief token deals combat damage to a player, it triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, the delayed triggered ability from step 5 triggers, returning Medomai the Ageless from exile to the battlefield.
Let the Identity Thief token die to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1309-1987-2427-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.

193-3908-4768.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double.
Spark Double enters the battlefield as a non-legendary copy of Aminatou.
Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill one card.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Aminatou enters the battlefield, triggering Altar of the Brood, causing each opponent to mill one card.
Repeat.
